#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

usage() {
    echo "usage: backup.sh SRC_DIR DEST_DIR [KEEP]" >&2
    exit 2
}

if [[ $# -lt 2 || $# -gt 3 ]]; then
    usage
fi

src=$1
dest=$2
keep=${3:-5}

if ! [[ $keep =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( 10#$keep < 1 )); then
    usage
fi
keep=$((10#$keep))

if [[ ! -d $src ]]; then
    echo "error: not a directory: $src" >&2
    exit 1
fi

stamp=${BACKUP_NOW:-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)}
archive="$dest/backup-$stamp.tar.gz"

mkdir -p -- "$dest"
COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 tar -czf "$archive" -C "$src" .

shopt -s nullglob
backups=()
for file in "$dest"/backup-*.tar.gz; do
    if [[ -f $file ]]; then
        backups+=("$file")
    fi
done

# Glob results are sorted ascending by name, so the oldest come first.
excess=$(( ${#backups[@]} - keep ))
for (( i = 0; i < excess; i++ )); do
    rm -f -- "${backups[i]}"
done

echo "$archive"

import os

import subprocess
import tarfile
from pathlib import Path

SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "scripts" / "backup.sh"


def run_backup(*args, now=None):
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env.pop("BACKUP_NOW", None)
    if now is not None:
        env["BACKUP_NOW"] = now
    return subprocess.run(
        ["bash", str(SCRIPT), *map(str, args)],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        env=env,
    )


@pytest.fixture
def src(tmp_path):
    d = tmp_path / "src"
    (d / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (d / "a.txt").write_text("alpha")
    (d / "sub" / "b.txt").write_text("beta")
    return d


def test_archive_contains_source_contents_with_relative_paths(src, tmp_path):
    dest = tmp_path / "out"
    result = run_backup(src, dest, now="20240102-030405")
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr

    archive = dest / "backup-20240102-030405.tar.gz"
    assert archive.is_file()
    with tarfile.open(archive, "r:gz") as tar:
        names = {os.path.normpath(n) for n in tar.getnames()}
        assert "a.txt" in names
        assert os.path.join("sub", "b.txt") in names
        assert not any(os.path.isabs(n) for n in tar.getnames())
        assert tar.extractfile("a.txt").read() == b"alpha"
        assert "src" not in names


def test_prints_archive_path_on_stdout(src, tmp_path):
    dest = tmp_path / "out"
    result = run_backup(src, dest, now="20240102-030405")
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    assert result.stdout.strip() == str(dest / "backup-20240102-030405.tar.gz")


def test_creates_missing_dest_directory(src, tmp_path):
    dest = tmp_path / "nested" / "deeper"
    result = run_backup(src, dest, now="20240102-030405")
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    assert (dest / "backup-20240102-030405.tar.gz").is_file()


def test_default_stamp_uses_local_time_format(src, tmp_path):
    dest = tmp_path / "out"
    result = run_backup(src, dest)
    assert result.returncod

e == 0, result.stderr
    created = [p.name for p in dest.iterdir()]
    assert len(created) == 1
    assert re.fullmatch(r"backup-\d{8}-\d{6}\.tar\.gz", created[0])


def test_backup_now_overrides_stamp(src, tmp_path):

    result = run_backup(src, dest, now="19990101-000000")
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr
    assert (dest / "backup-19990101-000000.tar.gz").is_file()


def test_default_keep_is_five(src, tmp_path):
    dest = tmp_path / "out"
    dest.mkdir()
    for day in range(1, 8):
        (dest / f"backup-2024010{day}-000000.tar.gz").write_bytes(b"old")
    result = run_backup(src, dest, now="20240108-000000")
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr

    remaining = sorted(p.name for p in dest.glob("backup-*.tar.gz"))

    ]

    result = run_backup(src, dest, 1, now="20250101-000000")
    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr

    assert sorted(p.name for p in dest.iterdir()) == ["backup-20250101-000000.tar.gz"]


def test_rotation_never_deletes_other_files(src, tmp_path):

    others = ["notes.txt", "backup-old.zip", "backup-20200101-000000.tar", "readme"]
    for name in others:
        (dest / name).write_text("keep me")

        "backup-20240101-000000.tar.gz"
    ]

def test_too_few_arguments_is_usage_error(src):

def test_source_not_a_directory_exits_1(tmp_path):

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

usage() {
    echo "usage: backup.sh SRC_DIR DEST_DIR [KEEP]" >&2
    exit 2
}

if [[ $# -lt 2 || $# -gt 3 ]]; then
    usage
fi

src=$1
dest=$2
keep=${3:-5}

if ! [[ $keep =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || (( 10#$keep < 1 )); then
    usage
fi
keep=$((10#$keep))

if [[ ! -d $src ]]; then
    echo "error: not a directory: $src" >&2
    exit 1
fi

stamp=${BACKUP_NOW:-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)}
archive="$dest/backup-$stamp.tar.gz"

mkdir -p -- "$dest"
COPYFILE_DISABLE=1 tar -czf "$archive" -C "$src" .

shopt -s nullglob
LC_COLLATE=C
backups=()
for file in "$dest"/backup-*.tar.gz; do
    if [[ -f $file ]]; then
        backups+=("$file")
    fi
done

# Glob results are sorted ascending by name, so the oldest come first.
excess=$(( ${#backups[@]} - keep ))
for (( i = 0; i < excess; i++ )); do
    rm -f -- "${backups[i]}"
done

echo "$archive"
